summary: The Princess Diaries is a 2001 American teen romantic comedy directed by Garry Marshall and written by Gina Wendkos, based on Meg Cabot's 2000 novel of the same name. It follows Mia Thermopolis, played by Anne Hathaway in her film debut, who learns she is heir to the throne of the fictional Kingdom of Genovia. The cast also includes Julie Andrews as her grandmother Queen dowager Clarisse Renaldi, along with Heather Matarazzo, Héctor Elizondo, Mandy Moore, and Robert Schwartzman.
